contradicting_evidence: BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC all rebounded in the latest completed hour, with positive hourly spot taker-buy balances.
Declining open interest during the rebound and non-positive live funding leave room for further relief without demonstrating renewed leveraged-long expansion.
ETH's latest settled ETF flow was positive at $4.4 million, so institutional flow evidence is not uniformly negative.
Fear sentiment permits a relief rally, although it supplies no reliable reversal timing.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The broad market is more likely to struggle to sustain rebounds and revisit lower prices than to establish broad recovery over 72h. Countertrend rallies remain plausible. BTC may remain relatively resilient, while the observed mid- and small-alt proxies face greater downside vulnerability. This is a directional bias, not a forecast of uninterrupted selling.
falsification_conditions: A sustained BTC and ETH advance that holds through pullbacks, accompanied by strengthening ETH/BTC and persistent participation improvement, would invalidate the failed-rebound premise.
Improving settled flows together with evidence of sustained spot demand and broader altcoin participation would materially weaken the downside case.
missing_evidence: Repeated breadth observations establishing persistence rather than one weak 24h cross-section.
Further settled ETF sessions to distinguish a recurring flow headwind from a single-session result.
Spot-demand and liquidity-deployment confirmation beyond the latest hourly rebound.
supporting_evidence: The breadth family shows 80 decliners versus 16 advancers, a median 24h return near -3.03%, and an equal-weight mean near -3.19%. This indicates broad weakness rather than an isolated BTC decline.

Within that same evidence family, large-, mid- and small-alt proxy equal-weight returns were approximately -2.47%, -4.24% and -4.00%. Only approximately 24%, 17% and 18% respectively outperformed BTC.
The latest settled BTC ETF session recorded a $137.9 million outflow, providing a demand headwind, though not proof of a continuing outflow trend.
Stablecoin supply declined approximately 0.15% over 1d, 0.68% over 7d and 0.54% over 30d, offering no observed supply-expansion support.
The positive hourly price move occurred with falling open interest and has not yet demonstrated durable demand or broad transmission.
